projects.title: Abstract Accounts
projects.summary: Smart accounts on mainnet: registry, names, IBC, module factory.
projects.description: Addresses below. Full account tooling is in abstract.js on GitHub.

projects.title: Staking
projects.summary: Delegate TERP, claim rewards, move or unbond stake.
projects.description: Validators, your delegations, pending rewards and unbonding, read live from the chain. Every transaction is simulated first so you see the fee before you sign.

projects.title: Terp Account Billboards (TABS)
projects.summary: Buy a username on-chain that points at your wallet.
projects.description: Register a name. Other apps can look it up. You can sell it after a cooldown.

projects.title: On-chain SVG collections
projects.summary: Mint SVG art that lives on Terp, not a server.
projects.description: Open the SVG UI to make a collection or mint.

projects.title: DAO-DAO
projects.summary: Governance apps on Terp — proposals, voting modules, treasuries.
projects.description: DAO-DAO deployment for Terp Network governance: proposals, voting, and multi-sig treasuries.

projects.title: No Rick
projects.summary: Prove a secret without showing it. Toy demo.
projects.description: Your browser makes a proof. Terp checks it. The word never leaves your device.

projects.title: IBC inventory
projects.summary: See which other chains Terp talks to, and fund relayer gas.
projects.description: Live IBC clients and channels. Optional deposits to keep relayers funded.

projects.title: Snapshots & install
projects.summary: Install terpd and skip genesis with a snapshot.
projects.description: Copy-paste installer plus the latest chain-state packs.

projects.title: Community bounties
projects.summary: Terp work in nine categories. First bounties coming soon: tasks appear once they are live on chain.
projects.description: The bounty board inside the Eco shield: nine category orbs, with the selected task and a Now / Next / Later board beside them. First bounties coming soon. You can already write a proposal; rewards can be any Terp token and are locked in an escrow once it is live.

projects.title: Permissionless.Money
projects.summary: Sister site: art mints and ZK demos.
projects.description: permissionless.money — fractals, minting, and the ZK hub.

projects.title: Penumbra
projects.summary: Private trading and staking: a DEX with encrypted balances and swaps.
projects.description: A DEX where balances, swaps and LP positions are encrypted on-chain, and every block clears at one uniform price. Assets arrive over IBC, for example USDC from Injective or Noble.

projects.title: REStake
projects.description: Let a validator compound your staking rewards for you: an Authz grant lets it send Delegate transactions to itself and nothing else. You can also claim and compound rewards yourself, one at a time or in bulk.

projects.title: Psychedex
projects.summary: The open encyclopedia of altered states.
projects.description: An open-access knowledge platform documenting altered states of consciousness: their phenomenology, risks, and how to reduce harm. Contributions are welcome; people review everything before it is published.

projects.title: Oracle
projects.summary: Osmosis prices read on Terp. Pay to fetch the latest.
projects.description: Prices from Osmosis, carried to Terp and kept on chain. Read the last price for free, or pay a small fee to fetch a fresh one. Every value links to the transaction that wrote it.

projects.title: Headstash
projects.description: The headstash claim page, loaded from chain: the page is stored in a frontend contract and its sha256 is checked before it runs. Look up an address, see what it can claim, and claim it.

projects.title: NFT Loans
projects.summary: Borrow against an NFT you hold, or lend to someone who does.
projects.description: Peer-to-peer loans with an NFT as collateral, on permissionless.money. Pick a piece you hold, set the terms, and a lender funds it. Repay in time to get the piece back. 4% fee to the Foundation DAO.

projects.title: NFT Raffles
projects.summary: Raffle an NFT you hold. The winner is drawn from on-chain randomness.
projects.description: Start a raffle with a piece you hold, on permissionless.money. Tickets are sold on chain and the winner comes from drand randomness verified on Terp. 4% fee to the Foundation DAO.
